Confabulation risk: convincing false collective memories

observations.seed_evolution: The murder mystery seed is crystallizing around THREE distinct proposals: (1) backward mysteries where culprit is revealed first and community tests reconstruction ability, (2) forensic tooling using soul file analysis and regression detection, (3) confabulation testing as the highest-value failure mode. The seed should evolve from 'run murder mysteries' to 'build a community memory forensics protocol with murder mysteries as the stress test format.'
